                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.closingBs {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hj₁ : ↑j₁ ≤ ↑i₂) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (L₁ L₂ : List (Monomial (HeckeGen n) × ℝ)) (hne₀ : ∀ q ∈ List.map Prod.fst (L₁ ++ L₂), q ≠ descWord i₁ j₁ ++ bsWord₁ i j₂) (hne₁ : ∀ q ∈ List.map Prod.fst (L₁ ++ L₂), q ≠ bsWord₁ i₁ j₁ ++ { index := i } :: descWord i₁ j₂) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (AlgElement.ofTerms (L₁ ++ (descWord i₁ j₁ ++ bsWord₁ i j₂, c) :: L₂)) (AlgElement.ofTerms (L₁ ++ (bsWord₂ i₂ i₁ j₁ ++ { index := i } :: descWord i₁ j₂, c) :: L₂))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The two Bokut–Shiao steps between the closing phase's two F-runs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      After fRun the moved term reads descWord i₁ j₁ ++ bsWord₁ i j₂, because its two halves close up: the left context [σᵢ₋₁] ++ descWord i₂ jpp ++ [σ_jp, σ_j₁] is descWord i₁ j₁, and descWord i j₁ ++ descWord jm j₂ is descWord i j₂. Both are descWord_split, one at each end.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The two steps sit at different bottoms, and that is invisible on the diagonal. The first is at j₂, the second at j₁. When b = a they coincide and any check run only there would pass; at b = a+1 the first redex is bsWord₁ i j₂, three letters longer. Read off the trace at a = 6, b = 7, not derived.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Bridging TOpen to fRun and fRun to closingBs #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Two list identities, each shared by both lineages. Neither is a step; they are what lets the closing phase's four lemma calls meet on the nose.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.trio_out_eq_fRun_source {n : ℕ} (i x y j₁ jp jpp jppp : Fin n) (S : Monomial (HeckeGen n)) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      trioLeft i x y jpp jppp ++ ([{ index := jp }, { index := jpp }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := jp }] ++ S)) = [{ index := x }] ++ descWord y jpp ++ (descWord i jppp ++ ([{ index := jp }, { index := jpp }, { index := j₁ }, { index := jp }] ++ S))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A TOpen word is an fRun source. Pure associativity once trioLeft is unfolded — fRun's left context is trioLeft without its trailing run.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.fRun_target_eq_of_left {n : ℕ} {i x y j₂ jm j₁ jp jpp : Fin n} (hjm : ↑jm + 1 = ↑j₁) (hjp : ↑j₁ + 1 = ↑jp) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hleft : descWord y j₁ = descWord y jpp ++ [{ index := jp }, { index := j₁ }]) (hi : ↑jp ≤ ↑i) (T : Monomial (HeckeGen n)) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      [{ index := x }] ++ descWord y jpp ++ ([{ index := jp }, { index := j₁ }] ++ (descWord i jp ++ { index := j₁ } :: (descWord jm j₂ ++ T))) = [{ index := x }] ++ (descWord y j₁ ++ (descWord i j₂ ++ T))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      An fRun target closes up into two descending runs. Both ends rejoin: descWord y jpp ++ [σ_jp, σ_j₁] is descWord y j₁, and descWord i jp ++ (σ_j₁ :: descWord jm j₂) is descWord i j₂. Both are descWord_split; hj₂ : j₂ ≤ j₁ is the regime, entering here as it does in trio.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.fRun_target_eq {n : ℕ} {i x y j₂ jm j₁ jp jpp : Fin n} (hjm : ↑jm + 1 = ↑j₁) (hjp : ↑j₁ + 1 = ↑jp) (hjpp : ↑jp + 1 = ↑jpp) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hy : ↑jpp ≤ ↑y) (hi : ↑jp ≤ ↑i) (T : Monomial (HeckeGen n)) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      [{ index := x }] ++ descWord y jpp ++ ([{ index := jp }, { index := j₁ }] ++ (descWord i jp ++ { index := j₁ } :: (descWord jm j₂ ++ T))) = [{ index := x }] ++ (descWord y j₁ ++ (descWord i j₂ ++ T))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      fRun_target_eq_of_left with the left split supplied by descWord_split, which is what a ≥ 4 has: there jpp < jppp ≤ i₁, so jpp ≤ y for both y = i₂ and y = i₁.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      At a = 3 the U lineage has y = i₂ and jpp = i₁ > i₂, so this supplier does not apply — and the identity is nonetheless true there, because descWord i₂ jpp is empty and jp = i₂. That is a different proof, not a weaker bound, which is why the split is a hypothesis rather than a side condition.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      def UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.WStar {n : ℕ} (i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ : Fin n) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Monomial (HeckeGen n)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.closingU {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm jp jpp jppp : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hjm : ↑jm + 1 = ↑j₁) (hjp : ↑j₁ + 1 = ↑jp) (hjpp : ↑jp + 1 = ↑jpp) (hjppp : ↑jpp + 1 = ↑jppp) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hjppi₁ : ↑jpp ≤ ↑i₁) (hleft : descWord i₂ j₁ = descWord i₂ jpp ++ [{ index := jp }, { index := j₁ }]) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (L₁ L₂ : List (Monomial (HeckeGen n) × ℝ)) (hsep : ∀ r ∈ List.map Prod.fst (L₁ ++ L₂), ∀ (X : Monomial (HeckeGen n)), List.length X = List.length (descWord i jppp) + List.length (descWord jm j₂) + 6 → r ≠ [{ index := i₁ }] ++ descWord i₂ jpp ++ X) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (AlgElement.ofTerms (L₁ ++ (trioLeft i i₁ i₂ jpp jppp ++ ([{ index := jp }, { index := jpp }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := jp }] ++ { index := j₁ } :: (descWord jm j₂ ++ [{ index := i }]))), c) :: L₂)) (AlgElement.ofTerms (L₁ ++ (WStar i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂, c) :: L₂))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The U lineage's whole closing run: fRun then closingBs, carrying the bystanders throughout, from a TOpen word to WStar.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        One hypothesis covers all five obligations. Every word this run touches has the form A ++ X for the same left context A = [σᵢ₋₁] ++ descWord i₂ jpp and an X of the same length — because both rules involved are length-preserving. Far-commutation swaps two adjacent letters; Bokut–Shiao takes descWord i j ++ [σᵢ] to σᵢ₋₁ :: σᵢ :: descWord (i−1) j, and |descWord i j| = |descWord (i−1) j| + 1. So hsep — no bystander equals A followed by anything of that length — is exactly what is needed, and it is discharged differently per bystander, which is the point:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • a word opening σᵢ₋₂ fails at the first letter;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • U1, which opens σᵢ₋₁ and shares the whole context, fails on length: it is A ++ X₀ with |X₀| one short, so List.append_cancel_left reduces the question to |X₀| ≠ |X|.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        No length formula appears: the same descWords occur on both sides, so omega closes each obligation with their lengths opaque.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        An earlier version of this lemma packaged the hypothesis as "every bystander opens σᵢ₋₂". That is false at the call site — the U run acts on TOpen's third entry, so U1 is a bystander and opens σᵢ₋₁ — and the lemma, though true and sorry-free, could not be applied. Sorry-freeness does not check instantiability.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.closingU_at_TOpen {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm jp jpp jppp : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hjm : ↑jm + 1 = ↑j₁) (hjp : ↑j₁ + 1 = ↑jp) (hjpp : ↑jp + 1 = ↑jpp) (hjppp : ↑jpp + 1 = ↑jppp) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hjppi₁ : ↑jpp ≤ ↑i₁) (hleft : descWord i₂ j₁ = descWord i₂ jpp ++ [{ index := jp }, { index := j₁ }]) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (TOpen i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm jp jpp jppp (hp.q - hp.q⁻¹)) (AlgElement.ofTerms [(trioLeft i i₂ i₁ jpp jppp ++ ([{ index := jp }, { index := jpp }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := jp }] ++ { index := j₁ } :: descWord jm j₂)), hp.q - hp.q⁻¹), (trioLeft i i₂ i₁ jpp jppp ++ ([{ index := jp }, { index := jpp }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := jp }] ++ descWord jm j₂)), 1), (WStar i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂, -(hp.q - hp.q⁻¹)), (trioLeft i i₁ i₂ jpp jppp ++ ([{ index := jp }, { index := jpp }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := jp }] ++ (descWord jm j₂ ++ [{ index := i }]))), -1)])

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        closingU instantiated at TOpen — the U lineage's run, in place, with the real three bystanders.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        This exists to check that closingU's hypothesis is reachable, which the previous version's was not. The discharge is the measured one: Vh and V1 open σᵢ₋₂ and fail at the first letter; U1 opens σᵢ₋₁ and shares the whole left context, so it fails on length — it is A ++ X₀ with |X₀| exactly one short of what hsep quantifies over, and taking List.length of both sides is the whole argument.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The V lineage's closing run, in place — fRun alone: the V side does not run closingBs, because its final step is the cancellation. It lands on WStar, the word the U side reached two steps earlier.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        All three bystanders are separated, and by three different arguments — measured uniform across a = 4,5,6 and b ∈ {a, a+1}, for each of fRun's three hypothesis families:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • U1 opens σᵢ₋₁ while every word here opens σᵢ₋₂ — head;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • V1 shares the head and is one letter short — length;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • WStar shares head and length — peel. After cancelling the common left context, every family word continues σᵢ (families 1 and 2) or σ_jp, σᵢ (family 3), where WStar continues σ_jp, σ_j₁. So the discriminator is σᵢ ≠ σ_jp or σᵢ ≠ σ_j₁, one letter in from the split.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        WStar is the reason the packaged hsep of closingU does not transfer: it is the one bystander neither head nor length reaches.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a = 3: the same construction, with the U loop as the identity #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        hecke_closing_from_topen.py's small-a sweep measures a = 3 at s1, s2 = 2 steps, U loop = 0, V loop = 1, two trios = 6 — the same a² − 3a + 9 = 9 the general case gives, and the same five stretches.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The U loop is zero-length for a structural reason, not by accident: at a = 3, jpp = i₁, so descWord i₂ jpp is empty and U0L and U0 are the same word. uLoop is not absent here, it is the identity — which is exactly what its parameter m = i₁ − jppp = −1 cannot express.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        vLoop runs one pass, and needs only jppp ≤ i, which at a = 3 holds with equality. That weakening (three commits back) is what makes this case reachable at all.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The U lineage's fRun and two Bokut–Shiao steps, then the V lineage's fRun, whose last step lands on the word the U side already reached. The two halves compose on the nose: closingV_at_TOpen's source is closingU_at_TOpen's target, because both were stated against the same four-term list.

TCancel's two WStar entries carry h and −h, so they contribute nothing; what survives is the two plain words. They are not adjacent — trio emits each lineage's h-weighted word immediately before its plain one — which is why this is ofTerms_cancel_split and not ofTerms_cancel_pair.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          openingPhase is a² − 3a + 9 of them and closingPhase the remaining 4(a − 1); hecke_closing_from_topen.py measures the two against the prefix length and they close exactly, 6/6 at a = 4, 5, 6 and b ∈ {a, a+1} — the diagonal b = a included.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          At a = 3, jpp = i₁ forces jp = i₂, and then descWord i₂ jpp = descWord i₂ i₁ is empty while descWord i₂ j₁ is descWord jp j₁ = [σ_jp, σ_j₁]. So hleft holds with both sides equal to that two-letter word — the same identity descWord_split gives for a ≥ 4, by a different route. That is why it is a hypothesis.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a = 2: the quadratic pair is already in U0 #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          hecke_small_a_decomposition.py measures the two remaining cases. a = 2 is a partial transfer: s1, s2 reach V2 unchanged and the V loop is trivial (jpp = i empties descWord i₁ jpp, so V2L = V2), but the U loop never reaches U0L and the trios do not apply.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The reason is the mirror of a = 3's. There, jpp = i₁ made the U loop the identity — it collapsed into the general construction. Here j₁ = i₂ makes descWord i j₁ only three letters, so U0 already carries the braid redex [σ_jp, σ_j₁, σ_jp] ++ (σ_j₁ :: R) that the a ≥ 3 loop exists to build. a = 2 falls out of the construction because the loop's output pre-exists.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Measured 3/3: the redex sits at L = [σ_jp, σ_jpp], which is exactly trio's L at A = [].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.U0_eq_quadPair_source₂ {n : ℕ} {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm jp jpp : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hjm : ↑jm + 1 = ↑j₁) (hjp : ↑j₁ + 1 = ↑jp) (hjpp : ↑jp + 1 = ↑jpp) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hj₁i₂ : j₁ = i₂) :

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          At a = 2, U0 IS quadPair's source. j₁ = i₂ forces jp = i₁ and jpp = i, and then U0's three runs telescope into the braid redex with L = [σ_jp, σ_jpp] and R = descWord jm j₂ ++ [σ_jpp].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.uQuad₂ {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm jp jpp : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hjm : ↑jm + 1 = ↑j₁) (hjp : ↑j₁ + 1 = ↑jp) (hjpp : ↑jp + 1 = ↑jpp) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hj₁i₂ : j₁ = i₂) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (L₁ L₂ : List (Monomial (HeckeGen n) × ℝ)) (hpark : ∀ r ∈ List.map Prod.fst (L₁ ++ L₂), ∀ (z : Monomial (HeckeGen n)), r ≠ [{ index := jp }, { index := jpp }] ++ z) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (AlgElement.ofTerms (L₁ ++ (CornerGeneral.U0 i i₁ j₁ j₂, c) :: L₂)) (AlgElement.ofTerms (L₁ ++ ([{ index := jp }, { index := jpp }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := jp }] ++ { index := j₁ } :: (descWord jm j₂ ++ [{ index := jpp }])), c * (hp.q - hp.q⁻¹)) :: ([{ index := jp }, { index := jpp }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := jp }] ++ (descWord jm j₂ ++ [{ index := jpp }])), c) :: L₂))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a = 2's U-side opening: quadPair applied directly to U0, with no loop and no bsStep before it. One term in, two out.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The a = 2 opening — the same five stretches, three degenerate #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          hecke_small_a_decomposition.py originally measured where the U lineage ends, which is its normal form, well past the prefix. Re-measured to the first cancellation the picture is the opposite of what that suggested: the prefix is 11 steps for every b, and a² + a + 5 = 11. The general count holds at a = 2, so does the phase split — a² − 3a + 9 = 7 and 4(a − 1) = 4 — and both phases are the same lemmas.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Three stretches degenerate, all because j₁ = i₂ forces jp = i₁, jpp = i:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • the U loop is absent, not the identity. descWord i j₁ is three letters, so U0 already carries quadPair's redex and needs neither the loop nor the trio's bsStep: uQuad₂ is trio minus its first step. At a = 3 the loop is present and is the identity, so the two small cases degenerate in opposite directions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • the V loop is trivial: descWord i₁ jpp is empty, so V2L = V2, and V2 is already the V trio's source.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • both F-runs are one step: descWord i jppp is empty, which is what fRun_gen was split out for.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The V trio, both Bokut–Shiao steps and the cancellation transfer unchanged. Every one of the eleven steps has its source word absent from the other terms, so the source-only relaxations cover this corner too.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The four words the a = 2 opening leaves, two per lineage, h-weighted first in each pair — TOpen with jp = i₁, jpp = i, and both trioLefts collapsed (U's to [], V's to [σᵢ₋₂]).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            CornerGeneral.V2 i i₂ j₁ j₂ = [{ index := i₂ }] ++ (bsWord₁ i j₁ ++ (descWord i₁ j₂ ++ []))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            V2 is the V trio's source at a = 2. descWord i j₂ opens σᵢ, which joins descWord i j₁ into bsWord₁ i j₁ and leaves descWord i₁ j₂ — the same meeting-of-two-halves as lineage_eq_trio_source, with the loop's descWord y jpp empty so no split is needed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.openingPhase₂ {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hjm : ↑jm + 1 = ↑j₁) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hj₁i₂ : j₁ = i₂) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (CornerGeneral.T0 i i₁ j₁ j₂) (TOpen₂ i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm (hp.q - hp.q⁻¹))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The a = 2 opening phase, whole — a² − 3a + 9 = 7 steps, T0 to the four-term TOpen₂. Four stretches rather than five: s1, s2, then uQuad₂ where a ≥ 3 runs a loop and a trio, then the V trio. No V loop, because at jpp = i it is the identity on V2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The two lineages run U before V, as at a ≥ 3 and for the same reason: after uQuad₂ splits U in two, V is the first entry of three. Each collision hypothesis is one letter — U's redex opens σᵢ₋₁ against the parked V2's σᵢ₋₂, and V's A = [σᵢ₋₂] against both of U's outputs, which share U's prefix.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.closingU₂ {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hjm : ↑jm + 1 = ↑j₁) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hj₁i₂ : j₁ = i₂) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (TOpen₂ i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm (hp.q - hp.q⁻¹)) (AlgElement.ofTerms [([{ index := i₂ }] ++ ([{ index := i₁ }, { index := i }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := i₁ }] ++ { index := j₁ } :: descWord jm j₂)), hp.q - hp.q⁻¹), ([{ index := i₂ }] ++ ([{ index := i₁ }, { index := i }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := i₁ }] ++ descWord jm j₂)), 1), (WStar i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂, -(hp.q - hp.q⁻¹)), ([{ index := i₁ }, { index := i }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := i₁ }] ++ (descWord jm j₂ ++ [{ index := i }])), -1)])

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The a = 2 U lineage's closing run: fRun_gen over an empty run, then closingBs unchanged — from TOpen₂'s h-weighted U word to WStar, the same word a ≥ 3 lands on.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            closingBs transfers because its hj₁ : j₁ ≤ i₂ holds with equality here. Its second bsStep is the step the engine reports as Y: at j₁ = i₂ the Bokut–Shiao rule and Yang–Baxter share a leading word and differ by a sign, and the Lean takes the monic one for the reason §4al gives.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The bystanders separate two ways, one fewer than at a ≥ 3: the two V words open σᵢ₋₂ against the run's σᵢ₋₁, and the plain U word shares that head but is one letter shorter than every word the run touches.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ
