                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.closingV₂ {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hjm : ↑jm + 1 = ↑j₁) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hj₁i₂ : j₁ = i₂) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (AlgElement.ofTerms [([{ index := i₂ }] ++ ([{ index := i₁ }, { index := i }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := i₁ }] ++ { index := j₁ } :: descWord jm j₂)), hp.q - hp.q⁻¹), ([{ index := i₂ }] ++ ([{ index := i₁ }, { index := i }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := i₁ }] ++ descWord jm j₂)), 1), (WStar i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂, -(hp.q - hp.q⁻¹)), ([{ index := i₁ }, { index := i }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := i₁ }] ++ (descWord jm j₂ ++ [{ index := i }])), -1)]) (TCancel₂ i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm (hp.q - hp.q⁻¹))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The a = 2 V lineage's closing run: one fRun_gen, again over an empty run, landing on the very word the U lineage just reached. No closingBs — the V lineage's two bsSteps were spent in its trio.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              WStar opens σᵢ₋₂ σᵢ₋₁ exactly as this run's source does, so the bystander argument here is the third letter: the source's is σᵢ, WStar's is σ_j₁, and j₁ = i₂ is two below i. Length does not separate them — both are |descWord jm j₂| + 6.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.closingPhase₂ {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hjm : ↑jm + 1 = ↑j₁) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hj₁i₂ : j₁ = i₂) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (TOpen₂ i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm (hp.q - hp.q⁻¹)) (TCancel₂ i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm (hp.q - hp.q⁻¹))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The a = 2 closing phase, whole — 4(a − 1) = 4 steps, TOpen₂ to the cancellation. The same three calls as a ≥ 3 (fRun, closingBs, fRun), with both F-runs one step because the run is empty.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.prefixChain₂ {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hjm : ↑jm + 1 = ↑j₁) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hj₁i₂ : j₁ = i₂) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (CornerGeneral.T0 i i₁ j₁ j₂) (TCancel₂ i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm (hp.q - hp.q⁻¹))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The whole a = 2 prefix, a² + a + 5 = 11 steps — the same count formula as a ≥ 3, and the same WStar cancellation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.TCancel₂_coeffEq {n : ℕ} (i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm : Fin n) (h : ℝ) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              (TCancel₂ i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm h).CoeffEq (AlgElement.ofTerms [([{ index := i₂ }] ++ ([{ index := i₁ }, { index := i }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := i₁ }] ++ descWord jm j₂)), 1), ([{ index := i₁ }, { index := i }] ++ ([{ index := j₁ }, { index := i₁ }] ++ (descWord jm j₂ ++ [{ index := i }])), -1)])

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The a = 2 cancellation. Same shape as TCancel_coeffEq: the two WStar entries carry h and −h and are not adjacent, so this is ofTerms_cancel_split.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a = 1: two bare quadratic steps, and nothing transfers #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              At a = 1 the corner is j₁ = i₁, so descWord i j₁ is two letters and both V0 and U0 carry a bare σᵢ₋₁σᵢ₋₁ from the start. The chain opens with a quadratic step on each term, where a ≥ 2 opens with a Bokut–Shiao or a Yang–Baxter. Measured: six steps, not a² + a + 5 = 7, and the cancellation word is bsWord₂ i₁ i j₂, not WStar. So unlike a = 2 this case shares neither the count formula nor the target; it is built, not transferred.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Every word is written over D = descWord i₂ j₂, which is empty on the diagonal b = 1 (there j₂ = i₁ > i₂). Writing them this way makes the bystander arguments uniform in b: the words have lengths |D| + 2 … |D| + 5, and at the three places where two collide they differ in their first letter.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The order below is not deg-lex's, which interleaves the lineages and at b = 1 takes a U step before the V one. MultiStepReduction fixes no order beyond each step's redex being present, so this runs the U lineage to its end first — and that is not cosmetic. Under the deg-lex order the U word after its bsStep and the V word after its braid are both |D| + 4 long and agree in their first three letters, so separating them would need a case split on whether D is empty. Running U first means the V words are only ever compared against words of a different length.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.V0_eq₁ {n : ℕ} {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hj₁i₁ : j₁ = i₁) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              CornerGeneral.V0 i i₁ j₁ j₂ = [{ index := i }] ++ ([{ index := i₁ }, { index := i₁ }] ++ { index := i } :: { index := i₁ } :: descWord i₂ j₂)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              V0 at a = 1. Two descending runs collapse: descWord i j₁ is [σᵢ, σᵢ₋₁], and the σᵢ₋₁ the S-polynomial inserts lands against the second of them — that adjacency is the quadratic redex.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.U0_eq₁ {n : ℕ} {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hj₁i₁ : j₁ = i₁) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              CornerGeneral.U0 i i₁ j₁ j₂ = [{ index := i₁ }, { index := i }] ++ ([{ index := i₁ }, { index := i₁ }] ++ (descWord i₂ j₂ ++ [{ index := i }]))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              U0 at a = 1. The same collapse on the other term: descWord i₁ j₂ opens σᵢ₋₁, and it meets the σᵢ₋₁ ending descWord i j₁.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.prefixChain₁ {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hj₁i₁ : j₁ = i₁) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (CornerGeneral.T0 i i₁ j₁ j₂) (TCancel₁ i i₁ i₂ j₂ (hp.q - hp.q⁻¹))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The whole a = 1 prefix, six steps: a quadratic step on each term, then the U lineage's bsStep and its second quadratic step, then the V lineage's braid step and its second quadratic step. The two h²-weighted copies of bsWord₂ i₁ i j₂ are what cancel.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The V lineage's braid step is bsStep at j = i₁ — the degenerate Bokut–Shiao rule that shares a leading word with Yang–Baxter — and on the diagonal b = 1 so is the U lineage's. The engine's trace names both Y.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.TCancel₁_coeffEq {n : ℕ} (i i₁ i₂ j₂ : Fin n) (h : ℝ) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                (TCancel₁ i i₁ i₂ j₂ h).CoeffEq (AlgElement.ofTerms [([{ index := i₁ }, { index := i }] ++ descWord i₂ j₂, h), ([{ index := i }] ++ { index := i } :: { index := i₁ } :: descWord i₂ j₂, 1), ({ index := i } :: { index := i₁ } :: descWord i₂ j₂, -h), ([{ index := i₁ }, { index := i }] ++ (descWord i₂ j₂ ++ [{ index := i }]), -1)])

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The a = 1 cancellation. Same shape as TCancel_coeffEq and TCancel₂_coeffEq: the two bsWord₂ i₁ i j₂ entries carry h² and −h² and are not adjacent, so this is ofTerms_cancel_split. What survives is the two plain V words and the two plain U words.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (AlgElement.ofTerms [(CornerGeneral.V2 i i₂ j₁ j₂, 1), (CornerGeneral.U0 i i₁ j₁ j₂, -1)]) (AlgElement.ofTerms [(CornerGeneral.V2 i i₂ j₁ j₂, 1), (U0' i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂, -1)])

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Joining the prefix to the tail #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                prefixChain lands on TCancel; tailChain and tailChainFromTwo start from a two-term element. What sits between is TCancel_coeffEq — a CoeffEq, not an equality — because TCancel still carries the two cancelling WStar entries.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                MultiStepReduction.refl is a syntactic constructor, so a coefficientwise-equal source cannot simply be substituted; MultiStepReduction.congr_source is the way through and its conclusion is a disjunction. Both disjuncts deliver the same thing here, which is why the join costs nothing beyond naming them.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                def UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.tailPair {n : ℕ} (i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm jp jpp jppp : Fin n) (c : ℝ) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                List (Monomial (HeckeGen n) × ℝ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The two words TCancel_coeffEq leaves — TCancel with its cancelling WStar pair removed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  def UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.tailMeet {n : ℕ} (i i₁ i₂ j₂ jp jpp jppp : Fin n) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Monomial (HeckeGen n)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The word both tail lineages meet at.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.tailPair_eq_tailChain_source {n : ℕ} {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm jp jpp jppp : Fin n} (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hjppid : ↑jpp ≤ ↑i₁) (c : ℝ) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    tailPair i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm jp jpp jppp c = [({ index := i₂ } :: (descWord i₁ jpp ++ (descWord i jppp ++ ([{ index := jp }, { index := jpp }, { index := j₁ }] ++ { index := jp } :: descWord jm j₂))), c), (descWord i₁ jpp ++ (descWord i jppp ++ ([{ index := jp }, { index := jpp }, { index := j₁ }] ++ { index := jp } :: (descWord jm j₂ ++ [{ index := i }]))), -c)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    tailPair is tailChain's source, off the diagonal.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    One descWord_cons_le does it, and it is applied to both entries at once rather than to the second alone: trioLeft i i₁ i₂ opens σᵢ₋₁ where tailChain's second term opens descWord i₁ jpp, and peeling that everywhere puts the two in the same shape without disturbing the first entry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.tailPair_eq_fromTwo_source {n : ℕ} {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm jp jpp jppp : Fin n} (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hjppid : ↑jpp ≤ ↑i₁) (hjm : ↑jm + 1 = ↑j₁) (hdiag : j₂ = j₁) (c : ℝ) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    tailPair i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm jp jpp jppp c = [({ index := i₂ } :: (descWord i₁ jpp ++ (descWord i jppp ++ ([{ index := jp }] ++ { index := jpp } :: (descWord j₁ j₂ ++ [{ index := jp }])))), c), (descWord i₁ jpp ++ (descWord i jppp ++ ([{ index := jp }] ++ { index := jpp } :: (descWord j₁ j₂ ++ ([{ index := jp }] ++ [{ index := i }])))), -c)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    tailPair is tailChainFromTwo's source on the diagonal.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    At j₂ = j₁ the two sources coincide, and only there: descWord jm j₂ is empty (jm < j₁ = j₂) while descWord j₁ j₂ is the single letter σ_j₁, so tailChainFromTwo's trailing σ_jp — which sits after its descWord j₁ j₂ rather than before — lands in the same place as tailPair's. Off the diagonal the two words genuinely differ, which is why neither tail statement subsumes the other.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.tailFromCancel {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm jp jpp jppp : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hjm : ↑jm + 1 = ↑j₁) (hjp : ↑j₁ + 1 = ↑jp) (hjpp : ↑jp + 1 = ↑jpp) (hjppp : ↑jpp + 1 = ↑jppp) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (hjppid : ↑jpp ≤ ↑i₁) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (AlgElement.ofTerms (tailPair i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm jp jpp jppp c)) (AlgElement.ofTerms [(tailMeet i i₁ i₂ j₂ jp jpp jppp, c), (tailMeet i i₁ i₂ j₂ jp jpp jppp, -c)])

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The tail, for every b — tailPair to the sign-pair at tailMeet.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The case split is on the diagonal, not on a: tailChain runs off it and tailChainFromTwo on it. Their targets are literally the same expression, so only the sources need reconciling, and the two lemmas above do that.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CornerLe.sPoly_le_resolves {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i i₁ i₂ j₁ j₂ jm jp jpp jppp : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑i₁ + 1 = ↑i) (h₂ : ↑i₂ + 1 = ↑i₁) (hjm : ↑jm + 1 = ↑j₁) (hjp : ↑j₁ + 1 = ↑jp) (hjpp : ↑jp + 1 = ↑jpp) (hjppp : ↑jpp + 1 = ↑jppp) (hj₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑j₁) (htop : ↑jppp ≤ ↑i₁) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∃ (E : AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ), MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (CornerGeneral.T0 i i₁ j₁ j₂) E ∧ E.CoeffEq (AlgElement.ofTerms [])

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The a ≤ b S-polynomial resolves, for every a ≥ 3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    prefixChain reaches TCancel, TCancel_coeffEq drops its cancelling WStar pair, tailFromCancel runs the tail to a sign-pair, and that pair is zero.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The CoeffEq in the middle is why this needs congr_source rather than a trans: TCancel and tailPair are the same element but not the same representation, and MultiStepReduction is stated on representations. The disjunction congr_source returns costs nothing — in the left branch the chain runs on from TCancel, in the right branch TCancel was already the endpoint, and either way the element is coefficientwise zero.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a = 3 is included: prefixChain₃ lands on the same TCancel, so sPolyResolves_le₃ differs only in which prefix it composes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The a = 2 tail #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    TCancel₂_coeffEq leaves a two-term pair, and it is not tailPair's: its first word matches, its second does not. tailPair's second carries a leading σᵢ₋₁ coming from the peel descWord i₁ jpp = σᵢ₋₁ :: descWord i₂ jpp, which needs jpp ≤ i₁ — and at a = 2, jpp = i.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     hecke_a2_tail_schedule.py measures it: 4m + 4 steps for m = |descWord jm j₂|, split 2m + 1 on the first term and 2m + 3 on the second. Both lineages are the same two rightward transports — σᵢ₋₁ past the run, then σᵢ past it — separated by one far-commutation σᵢ σᵢ₋₂ → σᵢ₋₂ σᵢ; the second term then closes with two Bokut–Shiao steps.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    No new machinery. The engine's trace names both closers Y, and both are B(x, x+1, x) — the coincidence already measured 16/16 for the a > b corner, where the Bokut–Shiao rule and Yang–Baxter share a leading word and differ by a sign that apply divides out. So bsStep covers them.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The a = 1 tail #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The last case, and the one that shares least. TCancel₁_coeffEq leaves four terms — h, 1, −h, −1 — never a two-term pair, so nothing stated on a pair can consume it; and one of the four carries a quadratic redex σᵢσᵢ from the start, the only tail in this arc that does.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        hecke_a1_tail_schedule.py measures it, 10/10 over b = 1..7: 2m + 2 steps for m = |descWord i₂ j₂| — transport the first term's σᵢ right past the run, transport the fourth's, then one quadStep on each word carrying σᵢσᵢ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The ending is not a sign-pair. Every other tail here lands on (W, c), (W, −c) and finishes with ofTerms_cancel_pair. The two quadratic steps emit four words: three land on words already carried with the opposite coefficient, and exactly one is fresh — [σᵢ₋₁] ++ D, created by the first quadratic step and cancelled by the second's. So this finishes on an explicit six-entry list whose entries annihilate in three pairs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        It needs q − q⁻¹ ≠ 0, which a ≥ 2 did not. The first term carries coefficient h, and a SingleStepReduction requires a nonzero coefficient to transport it; in the a ≥ 2 tails the transported terms carry ±1.
