                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Every composition with a non-empty left context overlaps in one letter. The general statement, over all four rule shapes, of what hecke_overlap_length_probe.py measures at n ≤ 8.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Three of the four are a length bound rather than an argument: the quadratic and far-commutation leading monomials have length 2, so one letter of left context already leaves exactly one; Yang–Baxter has length 3, and its one escape — a two-letter overlap [σᵢ, σⱼ] — puts σⱼ behind σᵢ at the head of lm₂, which lm_head_is_max forbids since j = i + 1. Only the Bokut–Shiao case needs overlap_length_one_of_bs_left.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Note the hypothesis is oc.left ≠ [] alone. The probe measures the proper compositions, where the right context is non-empty too; the Lean does not need that, so this covers left ≠ [] , right = [] as well.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4av From an arbitrary composition to the constructed one #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                CornerCriterion.bsbs_overlap_resolves (§4as) discharges the criterion's obligation for CornerGeneral.oc i i₁ j₁ j₂ … — a composition this file builds. IsGrobnerShirshovBasis.overlap_resolves quantifies over every OverlapComposition whose two rules lie in the system, and says nothing about how it was built. Between the two sits a gap that §4at framed as "the shape bridge": recovering left, overlap and right from the two lm_decomps.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4au closes it, because with the overlap known to be a single letter the two decompositions determine the rest outright. lm₁ = descWord i j₁ ++ [σᵢ] splits against left ++ [x] with matching tails, so left = descWord i j₁ and x = σᵢ; then lm₂ = [σᵢ] ++ right against σᵢ :: (descWord i₁ j₂ ++ [σᵢ]) gives right.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                bsbs_top_eq removes the last assumption a caller would otherwise have to supply. The two rules are not assumed to share a top index: the overlap is σᵢ from rule₁'s side and σ_{i₂} from rule₂'s, because a Bokut–Shiao word begins with its top, so a one-letter overlap forces i₂ = i and hence i₂' = i₁.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                bsbs_resolves_of_oc is the three together — the §4as result restated in the criterion's own form, for a composition the file did not build. It inherits every scope limit of §4as, the deep diagonal included, and adds one of its own: the left context must be non-empty, which is what §4au needs and what overlap_resolves does not require. The degenerate left = [] compositions are not covered here.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                All of this is the overlap half. The inclusion half is settled at n = 4 by §4m's inclusion_contexts_empty and is not part of what these sections leave open.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The criterion's obligation for an arbitrary Bokut–Shiao × Bokut–Shiao composition. bsbs_overlap_resolves speaks about the constructed CornerGeneral.oc; IsGrobnerShirshovBasis.overlap_resolves quantifies over every OverlapComposition. bsbs_oc_eq closes that gap, and bsbs_top_eq means the two rules need not be assumed to share a top — a one-letter overlap forces it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4aw The empty left context, and the cell closed #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4av needs oc.left ≠ [], because §4au does. overlap_resolves imposes no such condition, so that hypothesis is a gap in the coverage rather than a property of the compositions — this section closes it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                With no left context the first leading monomial is the overlap, so the second contains the first as a prefix: bsWord₁ i' j₂ = bsWord₁ i j₁ ++ right. Both words begin with their top letter, so i' = i and hence ip = i₁; and then the trailing σᵢ of the shorter word has to land somewhere in the longer one. It cannot land inside the descending run, where descWord_index_le caps every index at i − 1, so it lands at the very end — right = [] and the two descending runs coincide. descWord_bot_inj turns that into j₁ = j₂, which makes the two rules the same rule with both contexts empty, and OverlapComposition.spoly_isZero_of_self finishes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                So the degenerate case is not a separate reduction argument at all: it is the self-composition, which was already discharged. bsbs_resolves is the two branches together — the Bokut–Shiao × Bokut–Shiao cell of overlap_resolves, with no hypothesis on either context.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What it still inherits from §4as is the deep diagonal: hcov fails exactly when j₁ = j₂ = 0 and i₁ ≥ 1, because the a ≥ 2 reduction chains are built on j₁ − 1. Everything else is covered, j₁ = 0 with j₂ ≥ 1 and j₁ = j₂ = i₁ = 0 included. And this is one cell — the criterion quantifies over every rule-kind pair. Its inclusion half is a different matter: §4m settles it at n = 4 structurally (inclusion_contexts_empty, with no hypothesis about which rules are involved), so what is open there is the general-n form, not the half itself.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4az Towards §4m's antichain for every n #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4m settles the inclusion half of IsGrobnerShirshovBasis at n = 4: completedLMSet_four_infix_antichain decides that no leading monomial is a proper factor of another, and inclusion_contexts_empty turns that into "both contexts empty" with no hypothesis about which rules are involved. Both are decide, so both are n = 4 only. Generalising them is the better next target than another overlap cell, because it is half of the criterion rather than one cell of the other half.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                This section builds the structure that generalisation needs, and closes one of its two directions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                lm_split is the engine: every leading monomial is h :: (mid ++ [l]), and the four families read off uniformly through a single List.append_inj' — the interior is [], [σᵢ], [], descWord i' j respectively. From it:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • lm_interior_lt_head — the interior is strictly below the head. The two length-two families have no interior; Yang–Baxter's is σᵢ below σᵢ₊₁; Bokut–Shiao's is capped by descWord_index_le.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • lm_last_eq_head_or_far — the last letter is the head, except for far-commutation, where it drops by at least two and the interior is empty. That second conjunct is what lets a consumer discharge the exception rather than reason about it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • lm_cons_snoc — every leading monomial has length at least two.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                lm_not_proper_suffix is the direction that closes: no leading monomial is a proper suffix of another, for every n. Its proof is three of the lemmas in sequence and no case analysis of its own.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The other direction — proper prefix, and the strictly-interior case — does not follow from these. It needs two facts about descWord that the file does not yet have: that it has no repeated letter, and that adjacent letters in it drop by exactly one. The first separates a Bokut–Shiao word sitting inside another's descending run; the second is what rules out the far-commutation word sitting there. Neither is stated here, so the antichain is not generalised by this section — only half of it is.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.lm_split {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {r : ReductionRule (HeckeGen n) ℝ} (hr : r ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) {h l : HeckeGen n} {mid : Monomial (HeckeGen n)} (hlm : r.lm (heckeOrder n) = h :: (mid ++ [l])) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                mid = [] ∧ l = h ∨ (∃ (i : Fin n) (j : Fin n), ↑j = ↑i + 1 ∧ h = { index := j } ∧ mid = [{ index := i }] ∧ l = { index := j }) ∨ (∃ (i : Fin n) (j : Fin n), ↑j + 1 < ↑i ∧ h = { index := i } ∧ mid = [] ∧ l = { index := j }) ∨ ∃ (i' : Fin n) (i : Fin n) (j : Fin n), ↑i' + 1 = ↑i ∧ ↑j ≤ ↑i' ∧ h = { index := i } ∧ mid = descWord i' j ∧ l = { index := i }

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A leading monomial, split into head, interior and last letter. Every branch has the shape mid ++ [l] = <explicit interior> ++ [<explicit last>], so one List.append_inj' reads off both at once.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.lm_interior_lt_head {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {r : ReductionRule (HeckeGen n) ℝ} (hr : r ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) {h l : HeckeGen n} {mid : Monomial (HeckeGen n)} (hlm : r.lm (heckeOrder n) = h :: (mid ++ [l])) {y : HeckeGen n} (hy : y ∈ mid) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ↑y.index < ↑h.index

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The interior of a leading monomial is strictly below its head. The quadratic and far-commutation words have no interior at all; Yang–Baxter's is the single letter σᵢ below its head σᵢ₊₁; and Bokut–Shiao's is the descending run descWord i' j, capped at i − 1 by descWord_index_le.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.lm_last_eq_head_or_far {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {r : ReductionRule (HeckeGen n) ℝ} (hr : r ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) {h l : HeckeGen n} {mid : Monomial (HeckeGen n)} (hlm : r.lm (heckeOrder n) = h :: (mid ++ [l])) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ↑l.index = ↑h.index ∨ ↑l.index + 1 < ↑h.index ∧ mid = []

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A leading monomial's last letter either matches its head, or drops by more than one. Two–one split across the four families: quadratic, Yang–Baxter and Bokut–Shiao all end on their own top letter; far-commutation is the exception, and its drop is at least two by its own side condition.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.lm_cons_snoc {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {r : ReductionRule (HeckeGen n) ℝ} (hr : r ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∃ (h : HeckeGen n) (l : HeckeGen n) (mid : Monomial (HeckeGen n)), r.lm (heckeOrder n) = h :: (mid ++ [l])

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Every leading monomial has a head, an interior and a last letter — i.e. has length at least two. Bokut–Shiao is the only family where that needs an argument, and descWord_cons supplies it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.lm_not_proper_suffix {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {r₁ r₂ : ReductionRule (HeckeGen n) ℝ} (hr₁ : r₁ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hr₂ : r₂ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) {left : Monomial (HeckeGen n)} (hdec : r₂.lm (heckeOrder n) = left ++ r₁.lm (heckeOrder n)) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                left = []

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                No leading monomial of the completed system is a proper suffix of another. Half of §4m's n = 4 antichain, for every n.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                If lm₂ = left ++ lm₁ with left non-empty, then lm₁'s head lands in lm₂'s interior, so it is strictly below lm₂'s head. But lm₁'s last letter is lm₂'s last letter, and — unless lm₂ is the two-letter far-commutation word, whose interior is empty and so cannot contain anything — that equals lm₂'s head. Since a head dominates its own word, lm₂'s head is at most lm₁'s head, which is strictly below it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4ba The second of the antichain's three cases #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                lm₂ = left ++ lm₁ ++ right splits three ways, and §4az closed one of them.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                case status
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                right = [] — lm₁ a proper suffix §4az lm_not_proper_suffix
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                left = [] — lm₁ a proper prefix here
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                both non-empty — lm₁ strictly interior open

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The two are not the same argument run backwards. §4az reads lm₁'s head out of lm₂'s interior; this one reads lm₁'s last letter out of it, and the far-commutation exception is discharged differently — there by its empty interior, here by looking at what lm₂'s interior begins with. In both Yang–Baxter and Bokut–Shiao that first interior letter is exactly one step below the head (σᵢ under σᵢ₊₁; σᵢ₋₁ under σᵢ, by descWord_head), while far-commutation demands a drop of at least two.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The third case does not follow from these two: there is no way to re-associate left ++ lm₁ ++ right so that either applies, because lm₁ ++ right is not itself a leading monomial. It needs the two descWord facts §4az names — no repeated letter, and adjacent letters dropping by exactly one. The first has been checked to prove in two lines off List.nodup_finRange; it is not stated here because nothing here would consume it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.lm_not_proper_prefix {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {r₁ r₂ : ReductionRule (HeckeGen n) ℝ} (hr₁ : r₁ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hr₂ : r₂ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) {right : Monomial (HeckeGen n)} (hdec : r₂.lm (heckeOrder n) = r₁.lm (heckeOrder n) ++ right) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                right = []

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bb §4m's antichain, for every n #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4az and §4ba closed two of the three cases of lm₂ = left ++ lm₁ ++ right and named what the third needed: that a descending run has no repeated letter, and that adjacent letters in it drop by exactly one. Both are proved here, and the third case with them.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                descWord_nodup is the two-line fact §4ba recorded as tested. descWord_adjacent is the one that needed work, and the route is descWord_split plus uniqueness: splitting the run just above a letter exhibits its successor as the head of the second piece (descWord_last, descWord_head), and nodup_split_unique — a letter pins its own position in a duplicate-free list — matches that against the decomposition in hand. descWord_adjacent needs the letter not to be the run's bottom, which is where descWord_last earns its second use.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                With those, lm_not_proper_interior is a case analysis with two outcomes and no arithmetic: three of the four families repeat their head as their last letter, so they would put the same letter twice in a duplicate-free run (repeat_of_head_eq_last); the fourth is far-commutation, whose two letters are adjacent but drop by at least two, which descWord_adjacent forbids.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                lm_infix_antichain assembles the three cases, and inclusion_contexts_empty_general is §4m's inclusion_contexts_empty with the n = 4 hypothesis removed — same argument, general antichain underneath.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                This is not yet the inclusion half of the criterion. It says every inclusion composition has empty contexts and a shared leading monomial; turning that into inclusion_resolves still needs the classification of rule pairs on a shared leading monomial — either the same rule (InclusionComposition.spoly_isZero_of_self) or §4j's Yang–Baxter/Bokut–Shiao pair (DegenerateYbBs) — and that those are the only two. mem_heckeCompletedRewritingSystem_rules (§4at) is the tool for it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.descWord_nodup {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                List.Nodup (descWord i j)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.descWord_last {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} (hj : ↑j ≤ ↑i) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∃ (C : Monomial (HeckeGen n)), descWord i j = C ++ [{ index := j }]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The descending run ends on its bottom letter.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.nodup_split_unique {α : Type u_1} {L A C T S : List α} {z : α} (hnd : L.Nodup) (h₁ : L = A ++ z :: T) (h₂ : L = C ++ z :: S) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A = C ∧ T = S

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                In a duplicate-free list, a letter pins its own position.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.descWord_adjacent {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} {A B : Monomial (HeckeGen n)} {a b : HeckeGen n} (hdec : descWord i j = A ++ a :: b :: B) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ↑b.index + 1 = ↑a.index

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Adjacent letters of a descending run drop by exactly one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.repeat_of_head_eq_last {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} {left' mid₁ right' : Monomial (HeckeGen n)} {h₁ l₁ : HeckeGen n} (hmid : descWord i j = left' ++ h₁ :: (mid₁ ++ [l₁]) ++ right') (heq : l₁ = h₁) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                left' = left' ++ h₁ :: mid₁

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Inside a duplicate-free run, a word cannot repeat its own head as its last letter: nodup_split_unique reads the head's position two ways.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.lm_not_proper_interior {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {r₁ r₂ : ReductionRule (HeckeGen n) ℝ} (hr₁ : r₁ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hr₂ : r₂ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) {left right : Monomial (HeckeGen n)} (hdec : r₂.lm (heckeOrder n) = left ++ r₁.lm (heckeOrder n) ++ right) (hlne : left ≠ []) (hrne : right ≠ []) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                False

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A leading monomial is not strictly interior to another.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
