                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.lm_infix_antichain {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {r₁ r₂ : ReductionRule (HeckeGen n) ℝ} (hr₁ : r₁ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hr₂ : r₂ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) {left right : Monomial (HeckeGen n)} (hdec : r₂.lm (heckeOrder n) = left ++ r₁.lm (heckeOrder n) ++ right) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                left = [] ∧ right = []

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The leading monomials of the completed system form an infix antichain, for every n. §4m's completedLMSet_four_infix_antichain decides this at n = 4; this is the same statement proved, and it is the three cases above assembled.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.inclusion_contexts_empty_general {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) (ic : InclusionComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)) (hin : ic.inner ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hout : ic.outer ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ic.left = [] ∧ ic.right = [] ∧ ic.inner.lm (heckeOrder n) = ic.outer.lm (heckeOrder n)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Every inclusion composition of the completed system has empty contexts, for every n. §4m proves this at n = 4 off a decided antichain; with lm_infix_antichain the same argument runs at every n, and needs no hypothesis about which rules are involved.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bc The inclusion half of the criterion, for every n #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bb says every inclusion composition has empty contexts and a shared leading monomial. One thing stands between that and IsGrobnerShirshovBasis's inclusion_resolves: which pairs of rules can share a leading monomial.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                shared_lm_classify answers it — the same rule, or §4j's Yang–Baxter / Bokut–Shiao pair, and nothing else. Sixteen cases off mem_heckeCompletedRewritingSystem_rules (§4at), which is finally doing the job it was written for: this is its first consumer outside lm_cases, and the leading-monomial inversion could not have served, since the conclusion is about rules.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Eleven of the sixteen are impossible and most die on length — bsWord₁_length_ge_three kills every pairing of a Bokut–Shiao word with a two-letter one, with no arithmetic. The two live off-diagonal cases are Yang–Baxter against Bokut–Shiao, where matching lengths force the descending run to be a singleton (descWord_eq_singleton) and pin j = i − 1 — exactly §4j.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                inclusion_resolves_general then needs no structure bridge, unlike the overlap side's §4av. InclusionComposition.spoly_isZero_of_scaled already takes an arbitrary ic and asks only for empty contexts plus a coefficient identity, so the arbitrary composition is discharged where it stands: spoly_isZero_of_self on the diagonal, and relations_add_eq_zero with the two lc lemmas on §4j's pair — the same three lines ybBsInclusion_spoly_isZero uses on the constructed one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Half the criterion, and only half. IsGrobnerShirshovBasis also asks overlap_resolves for every OverlapComposition; there the Bokut–Shiao × Bokut–Shiao cell is closed (§4aw, modulo the deep diagonal) and the rest is not. This section says nothing about it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.bsWord₁_length_ge_three {n : ℕ} {i' i j : Fin n} (hi : ↑i' + 1 = ↑i) (hj : ↑j ≤ ↑i') :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3 ≤ List.length (bsWord₁ i j)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A Bokut–Shiao word has length at least three: bsWord₁_cons exposes two letters, and the descending run between them is itself non-empty.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.descWord_eq_singleton {n : ℕ} {i' j : Fin n} (hj : ↑j ≤ ↑i') {z : HeckeGen n} (h : descWord i' j = [z]) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                j = i' ∧ z = { index := i' }

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A descending run of length one is the singleton at its own top.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.shared_lm_classify {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {r₁ r₂ : ReductionRule (HeckeGen n) ℝ} (hr₁ : r₁ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hr₂ : r₂ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hlm : r₁.lm (heckeOrder n) = r₂.lm (heckeOrder n)) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                r₁ = r₂ ∨ ∃ (i' : Fin n) (i : Fin n), ↑i' + 1 = ↑i ∧ (r₁ = yangBaxterRelation i' i ∧ r₂ = bokutShiaoRelation i' i i' ∨ r₁ = bokutShiaoRelation i' i i' ∧ r₂ = yangBaxterRelation i' i)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Two rules sharing a leading monomial are the same rule, or §4j's pair.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The inclusion half of the Gröbner–Shirshov condition, for every n.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bd One bridge for every family, and the first column crossed #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4av built a bridge from an arbitrary OverlapComposition to the constructed CornerGeneral.oc, and it was written for that one family. Reading the file's composition namespaces afterwards: the reduction chains for the other cells mostly already exist — farComm_quad_resolves, yangBaxter_quad_resolves, bokutShiao_quad_resolves, quad_farComm_resolves, the four BraidSelfOverlap theorems, FarCommCyclic.bokutShiao_resolves, and so on. What is missing for each is only its bridge.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                oc_ext_of_left_ne_nil supplies all of them at once: two overlap compositions with the same two rules and non-empty left contexts are equal. §4au is what makes it true — with the overlap a single letter x, lm₁ = left ++ [x] fixes left and x, and lm₂ = [x] ++ right then fixes right, so nothing is left to differ. It needs no hypothesis about which rules are involved, and no case analysis.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                quad_right_resolves is the first column crossed with it: the criterion's obligation for an arbitrary composition whose second rule is quadratic, whatever the first one is. Each of the four branches reads x off lm₁'s last letter, names the constructed composition, and hands it to the chain that was already there — quadSelfOverlap_resolves on the diagonal and the three CyclicQuad theorems elsewhere.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                oc.left ≠ [] carries over from §4au, as on the corner side. The degenerate left = [] compositions are not covered here.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.oc_ext_of_left_ne_nil {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {oc₁ oc₂ : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)} (hm₁ : oc₁.rule₁ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hm₂ : oc₁.rule₂ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hr₁ : oc₁.rule₁ = oc₂.rule₁) (hr₂ : oc₁.rule₂ = oc₂.rule₂) (hl₁ : oc₁.left ≠ []) (hl₂ : oc₂.left ≠ []) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                oc₁ = oc₂

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                An overlap composition with a non-empty left context is determined by its two rules.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∃ (nf : AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ), ReducesToNF (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) oc.spoly nf ∧ nf.isZero

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The ? × quadratic column of overlap_resolves, for an arbitrary composition.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4be The mirror column, and the one place two chains are needed #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                quad_left_resolves is §4bd's column reflected: the criterion's obligation for an arbitrary composition whose first rule is quadratic. Same shape — the overlap letter is read off lm₁, the constructed composition is named, and oc_ext_of_left_ne_nil does the rest.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                One branch is not a mirror image, and the file's own docstring is what flags it. CyclicQuadLeft.quad_bokutShiao_resolves covers Bokut–Shiao at j = i − 1 only: bsWord₂ i' i j puts its extra letter on the left, so for j < i − 1 the second word is not of the form its chain needs. The rest is QuadBokutShiao, a whole namespace written for exactly that gap — "this covers precisely what §4q leaves open". So this branch splits on Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le and calls a different chain on each side. Nothing about the composition changes across the split; only which reduction reaches zero does.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                That is worth noticing before crossing the remaining columns: an existing _resolves may cover less of its cell than its name suggests, and the boundary is in the docstring rather than the statement.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.quad_left_resolves {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {oc : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)} {x : Fin n} (hql : oc.rule₁ = heckeRelation x hp) (hm₂ : oc.rule₂ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hl : oc.left ≠ []) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∃ (nf : AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ), ReducesToNF (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) oc.spoly nf ∧ nf.isZero

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bf The BS × FC cell is a four-way split — a map, not a result #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4be's lesson applied to the next cell, before writing any of it: read what each chain covers, not what it is called. Doing that for Bokut–Shiao against far-commutation turns up four namespaces, not one, partitioned by where the far-commutation rule's bottom index j₀ sits relative to the Bokut–Shiao bottom j. Both rules lead through σᵢ, so the composition is the same shape throughout; only the reduction differs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                j₀ vs j chain target
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                j₀ + 1 < j CyclicFarCommLow.bokutShiao_resolves CyclicFarCommLow.oc
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                j₀ + 1 = j BokutShiaoFarComm.oc_reduces_to_zero (§4o) BokutShiaoFarComm.oc
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                j₀ = j BokutShiaoFarCommSame.oc_reduces_to_zero BokutShiaoFarCommSame.oc
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                j < j₀ CyclicFarCommInner.oc_reduces_to_zero CyclicFarCommLow.oc

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The partition is complete: farCommRelation i j₀ exists only for j₀ + 1 < i and the Bokut–Shiao side has j ≤ i − 1, so every legal pair falls in exactly one row. Note the last row shares its target with the first while needing a different chain — σ_{j₀} lands inside the descending run there rather than below it, and CyclicFarCommInner is the namespace for that.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Why this is a map and not a theorem. The three upper rows would go the way §4bd and §4be do: name the constructed composition, apply oc_ext_of_left_ne_nil. The fourth will not. CyclicFarCommInner.oc_reduces_to_zero asks for four structural hypotheses — hsplit, hsplit', hB, hfarA — exhibiting how descWord i j breaks at σ_{j₀}, which a caller has to build with descWord_split rather than read off a leading monomial.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                So this cell is not the one-application-per-column shape the two quadratic columns had, and saying so is the point of this section. oc_ext_of_left_ne_nil still does the bridging; what it does not do is choose the chain.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bg The braid-word cell — the clean case, measured as such #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bf read the BS × FC cell before writing it and found a four-way split. The same reading applied to the braid-word families finds the opposite, and the reason is in their own docstrings: wHi i' i carries exactly two rules (§4j), and on the other side "rule₁ cannot double: j₁ ≤ i − 2 puts its leading monomial strictly longer than the braid word". So BraidSelfOverlap's four theorems are not a sample of a larger family — they are all of it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                lm_eq_wHi_cases turns that into something a caller can use: a rule of the completed system leading on wHi i' i is yangBaxterRelation i' i or bokutShiaoRelation i' i i'. The quadratic and far-commutation words are the wrong length, and a Bokut–Shiao word reaches length three only when its descending run is a singleton (descWord_eq_singleton), which forces j = i − 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                braid_self_resolves is then two applications of lm_eq_wHi_cases and one of oc_ext_of_left_ne_nil per branch. Note the bridge is unusually direct here: BraidSelfOverlap.oc takes its two rules as parameters, so the constructed composition already has the arbitrary one's rules and the rule-equality side conditions are the classification's own output.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Cells crossed so far, all under oc.left ≠ []: BS × BS (§4aw, modulo the deep diagonal), ? × quadratic (§4bd), quadratic × ? (§4be), and the braid word here. BS × FC is mapped but not crossed (§4bf).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.lm_eq_wHi_cases {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i' i : Fin n} {r : ReductionRule (HeckeGen n) ℝ} (hm : r ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hlm : r.lm (heckeOrder n) = BraidSelfOverlap.wHi i' i) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                r = yangBaxterRelation i' i ∨ r = bokutShiaoRelation i' i i'

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Only two rules lead on the braid word. No hypothesis relating i' to i is needed: matching a leading monomial against [σᵢ, σᵢ', σᵢ] forces i' + 1 = i in both surviving families, so the side condition is an output rather than an input.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The braid-word cell of overlap_resolves, for an arbitrary composition.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bh Bokut–Shiao against the braid word, both ways #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Measured before writing, as §4bf and §4bg were. BokutShiaoBraid.oc admits any j₁ ≤ i − 1, but its two chains require j₁ ≤ i'' with i'' + 1 = i − 1 — that is, j₁ < i − 1 strictly. The excluded endpoint is not a gap: at j₁ = i − 1 the Bokut–Shiao rule leads on the braid word itself (bs_hlm), so both rules do, and that is §4bg. The two sections compose to cover the cell, and §4bg is a prerequisite of this one rather than a parallel result.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                So each direction splits on Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le at the same place, and the two branches go to different sections. BraidBokutShiao mirrors it exactly.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                This is the shape §4bd predicted for the generic-namespace cells, and it holds here — with the caveat §4be added and §4bf illustrated: the split point came from reading the chains' side conditions, not from the family's name. Three cells have now been read this way and two were clean; the odd one out (BS × FC, §4bf) is still the only four-way split found.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A rule on the braid word against Bokut–Shiao — the mirror.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bi The four-way cell, crossed #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bf mapped this cell and stopped there. This crosses it. The map held — four rows, on j₀ against j — and row 4 needed what §4bf said it would.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                j₀ vs j chain
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                j₀ + 1 = j BokutShiaoFarComm.oc_reduces_to_zero (§4o)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                j₀ + 1 < j CyclicFarCommLow.bokutShiao_resolves
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                j₀ = j BokutShiaoFarCommSame.oc_reduces_to_zero
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                j < j₀ CyclicFarCommInner.oc_reduces_to_zero

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                One side condition the map missed. BokutShiaoFarCommSame.oc_reduces_to_zero also wants a jp with j + 1 = jp ≤ i − 1, which §4bf did not record. It is vacuous here — that row has j₀ = j, and farCommRelation i j exists only for j + 1 < i, so j < i − 1 already — but it still has to be supplied. Reading a chain's hypotheses is not the same as reading its docstring, and §4bf had only done the latter.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Row 4 is the one that is not a bridge application. CyclicFarCommInner asks for four structural facts about how descWord i j breaks at σ_{j₀}, and they are built rather than read off: descWord_split cuts the run at j₀, descWord_last peels σ_{j₀} off the upper piece to expose A, and descWord_nodup is what makes every letter of A strictly above j₀ — membership alone gives only ≥, and the chain needs >. All three come from §4bb, which was written for the antichain and is reused here unchanged.
