                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∃ (nf : AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ), ReducesToNF (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) oc.spoly nf ∧ nf.isZero

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Bokut–Shiao against far commutation, for an arbitrary composition.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bj The FC × ? row, and the instantiation §4q never made #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Reading FarCommCyclic's hypotheses rather than its docstrings — the §4bi lesson — turns up something the earlier cells did not have: a missing instantiation, not a missing bridge. The namespace exposes a generic oc_reduces_to_zero and two uses of it, bokutShiao_resolves and yangBaxter_resolves. There is no third, and FC × FC needs one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                farComm_farComm_resolves supplies it, and the fit is exact: farCommRelation m d is ofTerms [([σ_m, σ_d], 1), ([σ_d, σ_m], −1)], which is the family's normal form ofTerms [(σ_m :: u'', c), (q :: t, −c)] at u'' = [σ_d], c = 1, q = σ_d, t = [σ_m] — so hrel is fun _ => rfl, as it is for farComm_quad_resolves. The two blanket far-commutation conditions follow from d < m and m + 1 < x by omega.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                This is the first cell whose gap was a chain rather than a bridge, and it is worth separating the two: oc_ext_of_left_ne_nil (§4bd) still did all the bridging here. What it cannot do is notice that a family has an uninstantiated member.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                farComm_left_resolves then closes the row. The quadratic branch defers to §4bd's column rather than repeating it — quad_right_resolves already carries its own bridge, so no second one is built.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The FC × ? row of overlap_resolves, for an arbitrary composition.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bk YB × FC, and the ? × FC row closed #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The split point here was measured in advance: §4bj recorded it rather than leaving it to be re-derived, so this section spent nothing finding it. CyclicFarCommLow.yangBaxter_resolves wants j₀ + 1 < i', strictly stronger than the far-commutation rule's own j₀ + 1 < i = i' + 1; the single endpoint it excludes, j₀ + 1 = i', is exactly §4p's YangBaxterFarComm. Together the two are the rule's own condition, with nothing left over and no overlap.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                With that cell crossed the whole ? × FC row closes by dispatch on rule₁'s family — quadratic to §4be, Yang–Baxter to here, far commutation to §4bj, Bokut–Shiao to §4bi. The dispatch reads the overlap letter off lm₂'s head and then matches each family's last letter against it, which is what makes the four branches uniform.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                As throughout §4bd–§4bj this assumes oc.left ≠ []. The nil-left compositions are a separate question and are still open.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.yb_farComm_resolves {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {oc : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)} {i' i j₀ : Fin n} (hi : ↑i' + 1 = ↑i) (hj₀ : ↑j₀ + 1 < ↑i) (hr₁ : oc.rule₁ = yangBaxterRelation i' i) (hr₂ : oc.rule₂ = farCommRelation i j₀) (hl : oc.left ≠ []) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∃ (nf : AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ), ReducesToNF (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) oc.spoly nf ∧ nf.isZero

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yang–Baxter against far commutation, for an arbitrary composition.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.farComm_right_resolves {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {oc : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)} {i j₀ : Fin n} (hj₀ : ↑j₀ + 1 < ↑i) (hm₁ : oc.rule₁ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hr₂ : oc.rule₂ = farCommRelation i j₀) (hl : oc.left ≠ []) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∃ (nf : AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ), ReducesToNF (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) oc.spoly nf ∧ nf.isZero

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bl The nil-left compositions — the standing caveat, discharged #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Every cell from §4bd to §4bk carried oc.left ≠ []. The excluded case turns out not to need a cell at all.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                OverlapComposition places no condition on left or right, so left = [] is legal, and it says lm₁ is the overlap — hence lm₂ = lm₁ ++ right. §4ba's lm_not_proper_prefix then forces right = [], so the two rules lead on the same word, which is §4bc's shared_lm_classify: they are the same rule, or §4j's Yang–Baxter/Bokut–Shiao pair. The first is spoly_isZero_of_self; the second has both relations summing to zero coefficient by coefficient (DegenerateYbBs.relations_add_eq_zero) against leading coefficients −1 and +1, so the S-polynomial vanishes outright.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                So the nil-left case needs no family analysis and no reduction: the S-polynomial is zero, not merely reducible to zero. This is strictly more general than §4aw's bsbs_resolves_of_nil_left, which proved the same for two Bokut–Shiao rules only.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.overlap_spoly_isZero_of_nil_left {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {oc : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)} (hm₁ : oc.rule₁ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hm₂ : oc.rule₂ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hl : oc.left = []) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                oc.spoly.isZero

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A nil-left overlap composition has zero S-polynomial — no reduction needed, for any two rules of the completed system.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.overlap_resolves_of_nil_left {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {oc : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)} (hm₁ : oc.rule₁ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hm₂ : oc.rule₂ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hl : oc.left = []) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∃ (nf : AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ), ReducesToNF (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) oc.spoly nf ∧ nf.isZero

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                …so it resolves, in no reduction steps.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bm The overlap matrix, assembled #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                With §4bl the oc.left ≠ [] hypothesis can be discharged by cases, so the sixteen family pairs assemble into one theorem. Two of the four columns are already whole rows in disguise — quad_right_resolves (§4bd) and farComm_right_resolves (§4bk) each take an arbitrary rule₁ — so the assembly dispatches on rule₂ first, and only the Yang–Baxter and Bokut–Shiao columns need a second dispatch.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                overlap_letter is the shared step: the overlap is a single letter (§4au), so lm₁ = left ++ [z] and lm₂ = z :: right hold simultaneously. Each column reads z off its own lm₂ and then matches each rule₁ family's last letter against it. Every index identification in both columns is that one argument.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Two facts fell out of reading hypotheses rather than names:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • hq : q − q⁻¹ ≠ 0 was never a hypothesis. HeckeParams.h_ne_zero proves it from HeckeParams alone, so §4aw's bsbs_resolves_of_oc carries it redundantly; the assembly discharges it instead of propagating it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • i₁ = 0 is not a Bokut–Shiao case at all. bsbs_resolves_of_oc needs an i₂ with i₂ + 1 = i₁, i.e. i₁ ≥ 1. At i₁ = 0 both js are forced to 0 = i₁, so both leading monomials are bsWord₁ i i' = σᵢσᵢ₋₁σᵢ — the braid word — and §4bg's braid_self_resolves takes it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What is left is one hypothesis, hdeep, and it is sharper than the "deep diagonal" of §4aw. Forcing i' = i from the overlap letter forces ip = i₁ too, so at j₁ = j₂ = 0 the two rules are the same rule: hdeep is the longest Bokut–Shiao word σᵢσᵢ₋₁⋯σ₀σᵢ overlapping itself in its shared σᵢ. One self-overlap, not a family.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.overlap_letter {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {oc : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)} (hm₁ : oc.rule₁ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hm₂ : oc.rule₂ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hl : oc.left ≠ []) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∃ (z : HeckeGen n), oc.rule₁.lm (heckeOrder n) = oc.left ++ [z] ∧ oc.rule₂.lm (heckeOrder n) = z :: oc.right

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The overlap letter, read off both leading monomials at once.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.bokutShiao_right_resolves {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) (hdeep : ∀ (oc' : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)) (a' a e : Fin n), ↑a' + 1 = ↑a → 1 ≤ ↑a' → ↑e = 0 → oc'.rule₁ = bokutShiaoRelation a' a e → oc'.rule₂ = bokutShiaoRelation a' a e → oc'.left ≠ [] → ∃ (nf : AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ), ReducesToNF (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) oc'.spoly nf ∧ nf.isZero) {oc : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)} {c' c j₂ : Fin n} (hc₁ : ↑c' + 1 = ↑c) (hc₂ : ↑j₂ ≤ ↑c') (hm₁ : oc.rule₁ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hr₂ : oc.rule₂ = bokutShiaoRelation c' c j₂) (hl : oc.left ≠ []) :
