                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.overlap_resolves_general {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) (hdeep : ∀ (oc' : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)) (a' a e : Fin n), ↑a' + 1 = ↑a → 1 ≤ ↑a' → ↑e = 0 → oc'.rule₁ = bokutShiaoRelation a' a e → oc'.rule₂ = bokutShiaoRelation a' a e → oc'.left ≠ [] → ∃ (nf : AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ), ReducesToNF (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) oc'.spoly nf ∧ nf.isZero) (oc : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)) (hm₁ : oc.rule₁ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) (hm₂ : oc.rule₂ ∈ (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp).rules) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∃ (nf : AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ), ReducesToNF (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) oc.spoly nf ∧ nf.isZero

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Every overlap composition of the completed Hecke system resolves, modulo the one deep-diagonal self-overlap.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bn IsGrobnerShirshovBasis, modulo one self-overlap #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bc closed the inclusion half for every n; §4bm closes the overlap half modulo hdeep. The predicate is the conjunction of the two, so it follows.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The remaining hypothesis is neither a sorry nor an axiom: it is an explicit argument naming the one composition whose reduction has not been written. Everything else in the criterion — both halves, all four rule families, both context shapes, every n — is discharged.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                hdeep is not proved, and is not in doubt either: hecke_deep_selfoverlap_probe.py reduces both sides under the completed system and finds they meet for every i = 1 … 9, and that the answer does not depend on the rule order. So the completion is not missing a rule; what is missing is the induction. For i ≥ 2 both sides land on the same two-term normal form, and an induction has to hit it:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                bsWord₂ (i−1) 0 · descWord i 1 + (q − q⁻¹) · bsWord₂ (i−1) 0 · descWord i 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                (the second word is the first with a trailing σ₀, since descWord i 1 ++ [σ₀] = descWord i 0). i = 1 is degenerate — descWord (i−1) … collapses and the normal form has four terms.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The shape of that induction is also measured. For i ≥ 2 exactly one quadratic step fires, always on σ₀: it is the only coefficient-producing rule, which is why the normal form has two terms — the split's 1 branch drops two letters and its (q − q⁻¹)σ₀ branch drops one, so the two words differ by a trailing σ₀. Every other step is a length-preserving monomial rewrite. So the coefficient bookkeeping is a single heckeRelation split and the rest is word combinatorics. The chain grows: measured under that strategy it is i(i+5)/2 steps on the left and one more on the right — a size estimate for the induction, not a fact about the algebra, and reason to want a general step lemma rather than an enumeration.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.heckeCompleted_isGrobnerShirshovBasis_of_deep {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) (hdeep : ∀ (oc' : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)) (a' a e : Fin n), ↑a' + 1 = ↑a → 1 ≤ ↑a' → ↑e = 0 → oc'.rule₁ = bokutShiaoRelation a' a e → oc'.rule₂ = bokutShiaoRelation a' a e → oc'.left ≠ [] → ∃ (nf : AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ), ReducesToNF (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) oc'.spoly nf ∧ nf.isZero) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                IsGrobnerShirshovBasis (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The completed Hecke rewriting system is a Gröbner–Shirshov basis, modulo the single deep-diagonal self-overlap.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                hdeep is discharged in §4bw by deep_selfOverlap_resolves, and heckeCompleted_isGrobnerShirshovBasis at the end of this file is the unconditional statement. This form is kept because the two halves are proved far apart: everything above depends only on the conditional one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bo The doubled-descending-run sweep — side B's half of hdeep #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                §4bn left one obligation, hdeep. Its two sides need different chains, and this is side B's, in full generality.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The reframing that made it tractable is that the normal form factors:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                NF = bsWord₂ (i−1) 0 · descWord i 1 · (1 + (q − q⁻¹)σ₀)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                and 1 + (q − q⁻¹)σ₀ is exactly what σ₀σ₀ rewrites to. So the whole S-polynomial is one word with a σ₀σ₀ on the end, and the single quadratic step of the entire reduction is the last one. Side B's job is to reach that word.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                It does so by a uniform peel. The second copy's head σ_m closes the first copy into bsWord₁ m z; the Bokut–Shiao rule replaces it by bsWord₂ (m−1) m z = σ_{m−1}σ_m ++ descWord (m−1) z; and what is left is the same shape one level down. The bottom needs no step at all — descWord z z ++ descWord z z is σ_z σ_z. One rule, one step per level, i − 1 steps in all, and the induction is on the gap, exactly as descWord_split_aux is.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                pairSweep is the target word, σ_{m−1}σ_m σ_{m−2}σ_{m−1} ⋯ σ_zσ_{z+1} σ_z σ_z. It is defined by zipping the descending run against its own tail rather than by recursion, so no arithmetic on Fin n appears in it and pairSweep_cons is a descWord_cons rewrite.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Both statements are on a one-term element, which makes monicStep's side condition on the surrounding terms vacuous. The hdeep application will carry the other spoly term alongside, and re-establishing that condition against every intermediate is work this section does not do.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Side A is not this. Its route is doubly nested — a BS per level each followed by an FC sweep — and (i²+i+4)/2 steps rather than i − 1. It is still to be written, and so hdeep is still open.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                def UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.pairSweep {n : ℕ} (m z : Fin n) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Monomial (HeckeGen n)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                σ_{m−1}σ_m σ_{m−2}σ_{m−1} ⋯ σ_{z}σ_{z+1} σ_z σ_z — the word a doubled descending run sweeps to. Defined by zipping the run against its own tail so that no arithmetic on Fin n is needed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Equations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • One or more equations did not get rendered due to their size.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Instances For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.pairSweep_cons {n : ℕ} {m' m z : Fin n} (hm : ↑m' + 1 = ↑m) (hz : ↑z ≤ ↑m') :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  pairSweep m z = [{ index := m' }, { index := m }] ++ pairSweep m' z

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The recursion the sweep runs on: one pair peels off the front.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.pairSweep_self {n : ℕ} (z : Fin n) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  pairSweep z z = [{ index := z }, { index := z }]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  At the bottom the sweep is already done.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  §4bt CtxAvoids — the joining's context condition, threaded once #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  hdeep's two halves are proved (§4br, §4bs), but each on a one-term element, which is exactly what made every step lemma's side condition vacuous. The joining runs those chains inside the S-polynomial, where the other side's term sits alongside — so that condition now has to be discharged at every step of every chain.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Threading a bespoke condition through all of them would be miserable. One definition avoids it:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  CtxAvoids L a b — every word in L differs from every word of the shape a ++ _ ++ b.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Every intermediate of a chain that rewrites strictly inside a … b has that shape, so the single hypothesis discharges all of them structurally, with no proof obligation arising inside the chain. .extend grows a on the right and .extendRight grows b on the left — which is what a recursive call needs when it moves letters from the middle out into a context — and .ne turns it into the q ≠ W a step lemma asks for.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ctxAvoids_nil says the empty context avoids everything, so the one-term forms below are corollaries of the general ones rather than duplicates of them.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The head-letter separation §4bs measured is what will discharge CtxAvoids at top level, once the joining is written. It is deliberately not what is threaded through the interior: each lemma would then owe a proof about its own intermediates' heads, a second invariant to carry. ∀ Z, w ≠ a ++ Z ++ b owes nothing.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  def UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.CtxAvoids {n : ℕ} (L : List (Monomial (HeckeGen n) × ℝ)) (a b : Monomial (HeckeGen n)) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Prop

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The context condition the whole joining threads: every surrounding term differs from every word of the shape a ++ _ ++ b. Every intermediate of a chain that rewrites strictly inside a … b has that shape, so this one hypothesis discharges all of their side conditions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A doubled descending run sweeps to interleaved pairs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    descWord m z ++ descWord m z ⟶* pairSweep m z, by exactly one Bokut–Shiao step per level: the second copy's head σ_m closes the first copy into bsWord₁ m z, the rule replaces it by bsWord₂ (m−1) m z = σ_{m−1}σ_m ++ descWord (m−1) z, and what is left is the same shape one level down. The bottom level needs no step at all — descWord z z ++ descWord z z is σ_z σ_z.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Stated on a one-term element, so monicStep's side condition on the surrounding terms is vacuous.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.bside_to_splitWord' {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i' i : Fin n} (hi : ↑i' + 1 = ↑i) (L₁ L₂ : List (Monomial (HeckeGen n) × ℝ)) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hCh : CtxAvoids (L₁ ++ L₂) [{ index := i' }] []) :

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    bside_to_splitWord, carrying arbitrary surrounding terms.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Every word of the sweep sits behind the fixed prefix σ_{i−1}σ_i, so the single head condition "no surrounding word begins with σ_{i−1}" covers the whole run.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.bside_to_splitWord {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i' i : Fin n} (hi : ↑i' + 1 = ↑i) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (AlgElement.ofTerms [(bsWord₂ i' i ⟨0, hn⟩ ++ descWord i' ⟨0, hn⟩ ++ [{ index := i }], c)]) (AlgElement.ofTerms [(pairSweep i ⟨0, hn⟩ ++ [{ index := i }], c)])

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Side B of the deep self-overlap reaches its split word.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    B = bsWord₂ i' i 0 ++ descWord i' 0 ++ [σᵢ] is σ_{i−1}σ_i in front of a doubled descending run, so the sweep applies verbatim in that context and lands on pairSweep i 0 ++ [σᵢ] — the word σ_{i−1}σ_i σ_{i−2}σ_{i−1} ⋯ σ₀σ₁ σ₀σ₀ σᵢ whose single σ₀σ₀ is where the one quadratic step of the whole reduction happens. i − 1 steps, one per level.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    This is the hdeep obligation's B-half up to the split; the A-half is a different and doubly-nested chain, and is not this.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    §4bp Side A, swept — and a correction to what §4bo's measurement said #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    §4bo did side B. Side A opens with three fixed steps that land it on a doubled descending run, after which §4bo's sweep applies unchanged:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1. the second copy of the run is preceded by σ_{i−1}, so the first copy plus that letter is bsWord₁ (i−1) 0 — the inner Bokut–Shiao rule fires;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2. far commutation pulls the freed σ_{i−2} out to the front;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3. what is left behind it is descWord i 0 ++ [σᵢ] = bsWord₁ i 0 — the outer Bokut–Shiao rule fires, and its bsWord₂ puts a second descWord (i−1) 0 against the first.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    So side A reaches σ_{i−2}σ_{i−1}σᵢ · pairSweep (i−1) 0 in 3 + (i − 1) steps.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    This corrects a figure recorded earlier. The (i²+i+4)/2 reported as "side A's BFS-minimal route" is the distance to one particular split word, bsWord₂ (i−1) 0 · descWord i 1 · σ₀σ₀. Side A can split far earlier than that, at the σ₀σ₀ that pairSweep ends with, and getting there is linear. The quadratic figure describes a choice of split point, not the cost of side A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What remains for hdeep is one quadratic tail per side — measured i(i−1)/2 per branch on A and (i²−i+4)/2 per branch on B — plus the two-term bookkeeping. The two tails differ by exactly 2 at every i tested, which looks like B's branches reducing onto A's; they do not — checked to i = 6, no B-branch reaches its A-counterpart at all. The two tails are separate work.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.aside_head' {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i'' i' i : Fin n} (h₂ : ↑i'' + 1 = ↑i') (h₁ : ↑i' + 1 = ↑i) (L₁ L₂ : List (Monomial (HeckeGen n) × ℝ)) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hCi : CtxAvoids (L₁ ++ L₂) [{ index := i }] []) (hCi'' : CtxAvoids (L₁ ++ L₂) [{ index := i'' }] []) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (AlgElement.ofTerms (L₁ ++ (descWord i ⟨0, hn⟩ ++ bsWord₂ i' i ⟨0, hn⟩, c) :: L₂)) (AlgElement.ofTerms (L₁ ++ ([{ index := i'' }, { index := i' }, { index := i }] ++ descWord i' ⟨0, hn⟩ ++ descWord i' ⟨0, hn⟩, c) :: L₂))

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    aside_head, carrying arbitrary surrounding terms.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Its three steps sit in three different contexts, but each word begins with σ_i or σ_{i−2} — so two head conditions, CtxAvoids L [σ_x] [] saying no surrounding word begins with σ_x, cover all of them.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.aside_head {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {i'' i' i : Fin n} (h₂ : ↑i'' + 1 = ↑i') (h₁ : ↑i' + 1 = ↑i) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (AlgElement.ofTerms [(descWord i ⟨0, hn⟩ ++ bsWord₂ i' i ⟨0, hn⟩, c)]) (AlgElement.ofTerms [([{ index := i'' }, { index := i' }, { index := i }] ++ descWord i' ⟨0, hn⟩ ++ descWord i' ⟨0, hn⟩, c)])

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Side A's opening: three steps to a doubled descending run.
