                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MultiStepReduction (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) (AlgElement.ofTerms [(bsWord₂ i' i ⟨0, hn⟩ ++ descWord i' ⟨0, hn⟩ ++ [{ index := i }], c)]) (AlgElement.ofTerms [(bsWord₂ i'' i' ⟨0, hn⟩ ++ [{ index := i }] ++ descWord i' ⟨0, hn⟩, c * (hp.q - hp.q⁻¹)), (bsWord₂ i'' i' ⟨0, hn⟩ ++ [{ index := i }] ++ List.dropLast (descWord i' ⟨0, hn⟩), c)])

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Side B of the deep self-overlap resolves, in full — and on exactly the element side A reaches. The split's H-branch runs bside_branch at j = 0 and its 1-branch at j = 1; that one index is the only difference between them, and it is the extra σ₀ the split leaves behind.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      §4bw The joining — hdeep discharged, and the criterion unconditional #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Both sides of the deep self-overlap now run inside an arbitrary S-polynomial (§4bu, §4bv). What remains is to identify that S-polynomial and run the two chains against each other.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The collision this section was expected to have to avoid does not exist. Side A and side B reach the same two monomials, so running one chain with the other's normal form already in the context looks like it must eventually ask a step to fire on a word that is already present. It does not, for two independent reasons:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • AlgElement.isZero is coefficientwise — ∀ m, f.coeff m = 0 — and ofTerms sums the coefficients of terms sharing a word. Two terms with the same word and opposite coefficients are not an obstacle to be avoided; they are exactly the cancellation the S-polynomial needs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A step's side condition constrains the word it consumes, never the word it produces: monicStep's hne is used only to show the coefficient at a ++ lm ++ b is the c the step subtracts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      So the two chains run sequentially: side A first, with side B's word as its only ambient term; then side B, with side A's two normal-form terms as its ambient. The last B step needs its penultimate word absent from the context, and that word is one step short of side A's normal form.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The contexts are forced. σ_a σ_{a−1} ⋯ σ₀ σ_a has exactly one border once a ≥ 1 — the single letter σ_a — so left = descWord a 0 and right = descWord (a−1) 0 ++ [σ_a], and the two bsWord₁ placements of the S-polynomial are the same word and cancel. What is left is left · bsWord₂ − bsWord₂ · right, which is side A's opening word against side B's.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.selfOverlap_spoly_coeff {n : ℕ} {oc : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)} {L R : Monomial (HeckeGen n)} (hrel₁ : ∀ (w : Monomial (HeckeGen n)), oc.rule₁.relation.coeff w = (AlgElement.ofTerms [(L, 1), (R, -1)]).coeff w) (hrel₂ : ∀ (w : Monomial (HeckeGen n)), oc.rule₂.relation.coeff w = (AlgElement.ofTerms [(L, 1), (R, -1)]).coeff w) (hlc₁ : oc.rule₁.lc (heckeOrder n) = 1) (hlc₂ : oc.rule₂.lc (heckeOrder n) = 1) (hlm₁ : oc.rule₁.lm (heckeOrder n) = L) (hlm₂ : oc.rule₂.lm (heckeOrder n) = L) (m : Monomial (HeckeGen n)) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      oc.spoly.coeff m = (AlgElement.ofTerms [(oc.left ++ R, 1), (R ++ oc.right, -1)]).coeff m

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The S-polynomial of a self-overlap by a monic two-word rule.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      spoly = lc₂ • (rule₁ · right) − lc₁ • (left · rule₂), and when both rules are the same monic L − R the two L-terms are the same word: L ++ right = left ++ overlap ++ right = left ++ L. What is left is the difference of the two R-placements.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.ctxAvoids_head_of_ne {n : ℕ} {L : List (Monomial (HeckeGen n) × ℝ)} {x : HeckeGen n} (h : ∀ w ∈ List.map Prod.fst L, ∀ (t : List (HeckeGen n)), w ≠ x :: t) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      CtxAvoids L [x] []

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A context whose words never begin with x avoids x as a head.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.ctxAvoids_tail_of_last_ne {n : ℕ} {L : List (Monomial (HeckeGen n) × ℝ)} {b b' : Monomial (HeckeGen n)} {y : HeckeGen n} (hb : b = b' ++ [y]) (h : ∀ w ∈ List.map Prod.fst L, ∃ (u : List (HeckeGen n)) (x : HeckeGen n), w = u ++ [x] ∧ x ≠ y) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      CtxAvoids L [] b

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A context whose words all end in x avoids every pattern ending in a different letter y. This is the tail condition side B's unshuffle needs, and a last-letter comparison is all it takes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.deep_left_right {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {oc : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)} {a' a : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑a' + 1 = ↑a) (hr₁ : oc.rule₁ = bokutShiaoRelation a' a ⟨0, hn⟩) (hr₂ : oc.rule₂ = bokutShiaoRelation a' a ⟨0, hn⟩) (hl : oc.left ≠ []) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      oc.left = descWord a ⟨0, hn⟩ ∧ oc.right = descWord a' ⟨0, hn⟩ ++ [{ index := a }]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The deep self-overlap's contexts are forced.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      σ_a σ_{a−1} ⋯ σ₀ σ_a has exactly one border once a ≥ 1: the single letter σ_a. Any longer border of length k would need its first letter σ_a to equal the suffix's first letter σ_{k−2}, which happens only at the full word — and left ≠ [] excludes that. overlap_letter already does the length-one work; what is left is reading left and right off the two decompositions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.deep_selfOverlap_resolves {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) {oc : OverlapComposition (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n)} {a' a e : Fin n} (h₁ : ↑a' + 1 = ↑a) (ha' : 1 ≤ ↑a') (he : ↑e = 0) (hr₁ : oc.rule₁ = bokutShiaoRelation a' a e) (hr₂ : oc.rule₂ = bokutShiaoRelation a' a e) (hl : oc.left ≠ []) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ∃ (nf : AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ), ReducesToNF (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) oc.spoly nf ∧ nf.isZero

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The deep self-overlap resolves — the last obligation of heckeCompleted_isGrobnerShirshovBasis.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The S-polynomial is two terms, left · bsWord₂ and bsWord₂ · right, the bsWord₁ placements having cancelled. Side A runs on the first with the second as context, side B then on the second with side A's normal form as context, and the two normal forms coincide — so the four terms cancel in pairs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Nothing here needs the two sides not to collide. isZero is coefficientwise and ofTerms sums, so terms sharing a word simply add; and a step's side condition constrains the word it consumes, never the word it produces.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.heckeCompleted_isGrobnerShirshovBasis {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      IsGrobnerShirshovBasis (HeckeGen n) ℝ (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The completed Hecke rewriting system is a Gröbner–Shirshov basis — with no hypothesis left. deep_selfOverlap_resolves discharges the hdeep the conditional form carried.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      §4bx What the unconditional criterion discharges #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      HeckeGS.lean §7 states normal-form uniqueness and threading-cost uniqueness with the Gröbner–Shirshov property as an explicit hypothesis, and its own docstring records why: "NotAGSBasis.hecke_not_gs_basis_four shows the hypothesis is unsatisfiable at n = 4 for heckeRewritingSystem as it stands; it becomes usable once the Bokut–Shiao completion is added."

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Unsatisfiable is the operative word — those two theorems are vacuous as they stand, because hecke_is_gs_basis_false refutes the very hypothesis they take. They are not wrong; they are unusable, and deliberately so, pending this.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Against the completed system the hypothesis is now discharged, so the same two statements hold outright.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      They are not sorry-free in the same sense the criterion is, and the difference is worth stating. heckeCompleted_isGrobnerShirshovBasis depends on [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] alone. The two below inherit two more through normal_form_unique, both pre-existing library axioms of the Diamond Lemma machinery and neither introduced here:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • UGB.GrobnerShirshov.local_confluence — Bergman 1978 §3 Thm 1.2, the step from "all S-polynomials resolve" to local confluence, axiomatised because the three-case argument needs AlgElement subtraction;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • UGB.GrobnerShirshov.reduction_well_founded — Bergman 1978 §2 Thm 1.1, termination, axiomatised because it needs a multiset support representation and Dershowitz–Manna.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      So what this section establishes is: given the Diamond Lemma, the completed Hecke system has unique normal forms at every n. The GS-basis half of that is now proved outright; the Diamond Lemma half is still assumed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.heckeCompleted_normalForm_unique {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : HeckeParams) (f nf₁ nf₂ : AlgElement (HeckeGen n) ℝ) (hred₁ : ReducesToNF (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) f nf₁) (hred₂ : ReducesToNF (heckeOrder n) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem n hn hp) f nf₂) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      nf₁ = nf₂

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Normal forms in the completed Hecke system are unique — with no hypothesis.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      theorem UGB.GrobnerShirshov.Hecke.heckeCompleted_threading_cost_unique {n : ℕ} (hp : HeckeParams) (hadron : List ℤ) (nf₁ nf₂ : AlgElement (HeckeGen (n + 1)) ℝ) (h₁ : ReducesToNF (heckeOrder (n + 1)) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem (n + 1) ⋯ hp) (augmentedBraidElement hp hadron) nf₁) (h₂ : ReducesToNF (heckeOrder (n + 1)) (heckeCompletedRewritingSystem (n + 1) ⋯ hp) (augmentedBraidElement hp hadron) nf₂) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      nf₁ = nf₂

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Threading cost is well-defined — with no hypothesis.
